title: Add a skill to Intendancy Registry
description: Someone requested to add an agent skill to the Intendancy Registry.
question: Does this skill comply with the Intendancy listing policy?

descriptions: Select this if the skill complies with all acceptance criteria in the listing policy and should be added to the registry.
Select this if the skill violates one or more acceptance criteria and should not be added.

metadata.tcrDescription: An optimistic Kleros-curated registry of AI agent skills.

columns.label: Name
columns.description: Must be byte-identical to the name field in the skill tree's SKILL.md frontmatter.

columns.label: Description
columns.description: Must be byte-identical to the description field in the skill tree's SKILL.md frontmatter.

columns.label: Tree CID
columns.description: Bare canonical CIDv1 (base32, lowercase), DAG-PB with a 32-byte SHA-256 multihash, identifying the complete UnixFS skill directory.

columns.label: Runtimes
columns.description: Comma-separated supported agent runtimes (for example, claude_code,generic).

columns.label: Origin
columns.description: Optional provenance claim. If present, evidence must bind the exact submitted semantic skill tree under the listing policy, not merely the same owner, domain, account, or repository.

columns.label: Reserved
columns.description: Reserved for a future policy version. Must be the empty string under the current policy.
